```{r setup}
library(popmex)
```

This tutorial demonstrates how to extract population data at the municipality level, using census data from INEGI (2000, 2010, and 2020) as well as population estimates and projections from CONAPO.


## INEGI 


```{r pop-inegi-2000}
gtExtras::gt_plt_summary(popmex::pop2000, title = "Total population from the 2000 Census")
```

```{r pop-inegi-2010}
gtExtras::gt_plt_summary(popmex::pop2010, title = "Total population from the 2010 Census")
```


```{r pop-inegi-2020}
gtExtras::gt_plt_summary(popmex::pop2020, title = "Total population from the 2020 Census")
```
